step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows real-time connected vehicle data flowing from an external ThirdParty (Kafka on AWS platform) into a VPC. From the VPC, the stream flows into a LIVE EMR cluster which processes live telemetry data and stores raw data in an S3 bucket. A BATCH EMR cluster reads from the S3 bucket and processes data into two S3 buckets: PARQUET and KPI. The PARQUET bucket feeds downstream analytics and ML via SageMaker and Athena. The KPI bucket feeds aggregated data into RedShift for reporting. An un-connected RDS instance stores transactional and metadata.
